subject.why: The pink feather duster with a wooden handle and red ribbon is instantly recognizable and fully depicted.

category.why: The object floats at an angle with no ground beneath it, set against a saturated blue background with radiating rays.

clean.why: The image is completely free of text, UI, borders, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: The feather duster is nicely centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: The bright pink, red, and warm wood tones contrast vividly with the rich blue sunburst background.

detail.why: The feathers are simplified into clean, chunky shapes without any busy textures or micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with smooth 3D volumes, soft satin sheen, and clean rendering without outlines.
